name: Can Gio salt pans
kicker: Dry-season pans at Lý Nhơn and Cần Thạnh
summary: Walk the pans on a hard sunny morning from December through May. Phụ Nữ, on 10 March 2024, prints about 1,500 ha at Lý Nhơn, Cần Thạnh, and Thạnh An. Dân trí, on 14 January 2020, prints about 1,200 ha in production. A ticket was not printed. Check on arrival. Skip the pans in the rains.
dotReason: A morning in season, not the reason for the night.
getThere: Đường Duyên Hải in the town, or the fields at Lý Nhơn. Minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: Salt pans at Lý Nhơn in the evening light

notice.title: The harvest is December–May
notice.body: Both salt stories put the season in those months. Outside them, the pans are the wrong reason to make the ferry ride.

body: The pans sit along đường Duyên Hải in the old town, in the fields at Lý Nhơn, now inside xã An Thới Đông, and on đảo Thiềng Liềng in xã Thạnh An. Phụ Nữ says most pans now crystallize on tarpaulin. Dân trí says the city recognized the Cần Thạnh village as a traditional craft village, and that visitors join a salt morning.

Phụ Nữ, on 10 March 2024, prints about 1,500 ha at those three places, and crystals in 7–10 days of hard sun. Dân trí, on 14 January 2020, prints about 1,200 ha in production, more than 1,000 ha on tarpaulin, a yield of 80 tons a hectare, and 7–9 days from the first crystal to harvest. Both stories put the season at December–May. Go after sunrise. Dân trí says the picture is at dawn, and that the heavy part of the job is the noon rake.

A ticket was not printed. Check on arrival. Minutes to Lý Nhơn or Thiềng Liềng were not printed. For the Cần Thạnh salt village, Dân trí prints about 30 km in the lead, about 60 km in the body of the same story, and about 30 km south from the old district centre. A boat to Thạnh An was not opened. Salt is what people carry home.

figures.caption: Cần Thạnh pans in hard sun, a different hour from the Lý Nhơn evening
figures.alt: A path between sunlit salt pans at Cần Thạnh

gettingThere: From the beach town, đường Duyên Hải is the town road. The Lý Nhơn fields are now inside xã An Thới Đông. Minutes were not printed. Check on arrival.

From Ho Chi Minh City, the ferry is the crossing. Visit HCMC prints about 1 hour 30 minutes and about 50 km to the forest. Tuổi Trẻ prints about 2 hours. Dân trí’s three distances for the salt village all stay: about 30 km in the lead, about 60 km in the body, and about 30 km south from the old district centre.

legs.heading: From the beach town
legs.body: Đường Duyên Hải, then the Lý Nhơn fields. Minutes to Lý Nhơn and to Thiềng Liềng were not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Ho Chi Minh City
legs.body: The Bình Khánh ferry, then the town or the Lý Nhơn road. About 1 hour 30 minutes and about 50 km on Visit HCMC, or about 2 hours in Tuổi Trẻ. Dân trí prints about 30 km, about 60 km, and about 30 km south for the salt village.

closed: Both stories limit the harvest to December–May. A daily opening hour was not printed.
